trajectory.thought: The leader is the seeded baseline (median of all 19 models) and the verdict is "indistinguishable" — the runner-up is not statistically better. The series has unstable ranking, correlated errors, and only 3 validation windows, making any fitted weighting high-variance. The robust median is well-suited to this regime, and the stopping criteria are met.

action_args.justification: The series exhibits strong trend and seasonality with unstable model ranking (Kendall tau ~0.02) and correlated error groups, making robust aggregation preferable to fitted weights. The median of the full pool is the best-scoring strategy and the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable. With only 3 validation windows, weight estimation is high-variance, so the simple robust median is the safest choice.
